verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs for finer programmatic control (unity-docs-11) and editor extension (unity-docs-10). It also documents command-line and headless control of the Editor and Player (unity-docs-7, unity-docs-8). A first-party CLI with structured JSON/TSV output, documented exit codes, and `unity <command>`/`unity eval` drives the Editor directly for agents (unity-probe-rt-4), and an official MCP server mode is available (unity-docs-23, unity-probe-rt-4). Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), the agent-oriented CLI is still experimental, the core manual has no llms.txt or markdown mirrors, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
